pragmaAvailabilityLocal: all three PRAGMAs (page_count, freelist_count, page_size) answered on the local engine

reconciliationContract.scope: per-object first-party samples reconcile IN AGGREGATE to the namespace-level provider stored-data bill (no per-stable-id provider feed assumed)
reconciliationContract.aggregationWindow: calendar month, sampled at the estimator cadence
reconciliationContract.nonSnapbackResources: namespace resources not owned by a Snapback environment are excluded from the allocation rule and absorbed by the platform, never billed to a customer
reconciliationContract.allocationRule: customer share = customer billed logical bytes / sum of all Snapback-environment billed logical bytes in the namespace, applied to the provider stored-data line
reconciliationContract.toleranceEscalation: aggregate |provider - sum(first-party)| / provider tracked per window; > 5% for two consecutive windows escalates to operations and freezes price changes until explained

gate0OpenItem: DO-SQLite PRAGMA availability (page_count/freelist_count/page_size) is NOT proven by this local run; it is the explicit Gate-0 verification 0105 requires on the real target, and missing support there fails the DO-SQLite billing basis rather than falling back to databaseSize
